name: Cleaner Production Candidate
prompt: Using the provided approved parent concept as reference, generate a cleaner production-ready isolated concept of a potion bottle draught. Preserve the approved art direction and reusable components, but simplify clutter, remove overlap, and make the asset stand on its own on a plain background. Keep the materials glass, cork, iron, worn labels, the mood grounded, warm, alchemical, practical, and the silhouette game-readable for first-person distance.
